items.summary_en: Pillar Point Studios/YouTube Ellie Nesler, the California mother who killed the man accused of molesting her son in 1993. On April 2, 1993, Ellie Nesler walked into a small courtroom in Jamestown, California, and shot Daniel Mark Driver, the man who was accused of sexually assaulting her young son. Driver died at the scene, and people across the nation initially praised Nesler for her vigilantism. items.summary_en: Freeman’s Gertrude Abercrombie’s 1951 painting Alderman Merriam’s Shells was rediscovered in 2025 when it was bought at an estate sale for $30. When a collector was browsing the offerings at a picked-over estate sale in Kalamazoo, Michigan in 2025, he ended up coming across an interesting looking painting and bought it for $30.
